editor_version: Epic HoopoeEditor 1.1.390.0e; UE 4.26.2; configuration from project post-install evidence
scope_status: PROPOSED_BOUNDED_RESEARCH_COLLECTION; exact installed file identities observed; collection not performed by this manifest
limitations: This allowlist covers known concrete source questions. It cannot guarantee all data needed for the eventual mod, expose unavailable native C++ bodies, or establish shipping-game behavior.
Previously reviewed source graphs may be reused only after matching both installed asset and retained export hashes. They are editor source observations, not live order acceptance.

Expected asset types are validation targets. Validate the actual editor class, including supported subclasses, before choosing export handling. BehaviorTree and BlackboardData must not be treated as Blueprint graphs.

No dependency crawl or automatic discovered-asset expansion is authorized by this manifest. Exact asset loading can still make Unreal resolve hard dependencies, use RAM, create ordinary cache activity, or compile shaders internally.

Availability, content completeness, generated defaults, tree/blackboard text export and resource cost remain unverified until the proposed collector runs; report missing, incompatible or failed items separately.

Native MWSquad.get_members_for_order implementation, controller authority, current human possession, manual supersession, order acceptance, loading/pause behavior, network replication and shipping transport require further source or separately authorized runtime validation.
No game launch, gameplay dispatch, Play-In-Editor, save, explicit compile, cook, mod creation, deployment or audio operation is part of this scope.
